name: EURUSD Session Volatility: Tokyo vs London vs NY
description: Compares intraday pip range volatility across three FX sessions for EURUSD: Tokyo (19:00–00:00 ET), London (03:00–08:00 ET), and NY (08:00–17:00 ET). For each session, computes the daily high-low range in pips (×10,000). Output: (1) summary stats table with avg, median, std dev per session, (2) boxplot of session range distributions side by side, (3) 20-day rolling average pip range line chart to show volatility regime shifts over time.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EURUSD Session Volatility: Tokyo vs London vs NY
# =============================================================================
# Sessions (all times Eastern):
#   Tokyo:  19:00 - 00:00 ET  (prior day evening to midnight)
#   London: 03:00 - 08:00 ET
#   NY:     08:00 - 17:00 ET
# Pip range = (session high - session low) * 10000
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1-Min EURUSD) ===
src = market_data_source()()

# === HOLIDAY FILTER (FX calendar) ===
is_holiday = holiday(days_before=0, days_after=0, holiday_calendar=HolidayCalendar.FXHolidayCalendar)

# === SESSION WINDOWS ===
tokyo_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='19:00', end='00:00', tz='America/New_York'))(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)
london_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='03:00', end='08:00', tz='America/New_York'))(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)
ny_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='08:00', end='17:00', tz='America/New_York'))(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)

# === SESSION VALIDITY (closed and not holiday) ===
tokyo_valid = tokyo_sw.closed and not is_holiday
london_valid = london_sw.closed and not is_holiday
ny_valid = ny_sw.closed and not is_holiday

# === SESSION PIP RANGES (sparse: one value per session close bar) ===
tokyo_range_pips = where(tokyo_valid, (tokyo_sw.high - tokyo_sw.low) * 10000)
london_range_pips = where(london_valid, (london_sw.high - london_sw.low) * 10000)
ny_range_pips = where(ny_valid, (ny_sw.high - ny_sw.low) * 10000)

# === DOWNSAMPLE TO DAILY (one observation per day per session) ===
tokyo_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.max)(tokyo_range_pips)
london_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.max)(london_range_pips)
ny_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.max)(ny_range_pips)

# === 20-DAY ROLLING AVERAGES (daily bars) ===
tokyo_ma20 = ma(period=20, timeframe=1D)(tokyo_daily)
london_ma20 = ma(period=20, timeframe=1D)(london_daily)
ny_ma20 = ma(period=20, timeframe=1D)(ny_daily)

# === DAILY TIMESTAMP FOR LINE CHART ===
daily_ts = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(index())

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Summary Statistics Table ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EURUSD Session Pip Range Statistics',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Tokyo (19:00-00:00 ET)', 'London (03:00-08:00 ET)', 'NY (08:00-17:00 ET)'],
        col_headers=['Avg Range (pips)', 'Median Range (pips)', 'Std Dev (pips)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Session Volatility',
    order=0
)(tokyo_daily, tokyo_daily, tokyo_daily, london_daily, london_daily, london_daily, ny_daily, ny_daily, ny_daily)

# --- 2. Boxplot: Session Range Distributions Side by Side ---
boxplot(
    title='Session Range Distribution: Tokyo vs London vs NY',
    category='Session Volatility',
    series_names=['Tokyo (19:00-00:00)', 'London (03:00-08:00)', 'NY (08:00-17:00)'],
    y_axis_label='Pip Range',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    colors=[Color.Teal, Color.Blue, Color.Indigo],
    order=1
)(values=(tokyo_daily, london_daily, ny_daily))

# --- 3. Rolling 20-Day Average Pip Range Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title='20-Day Rolling Avg Pip Range by Session',
    category='Session Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Avg Pip Range (20d)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Tokyo', color=Color.Teal),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='London', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NY', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    order=2,
    timeframe=1D
)(x_values=daily_ts, y_values=(tokyo_ma20, london_ma20, ny_ma20))
